subject: general
question: Town T is to the west of Town S. Town U is to the south of Town T. Town V is to the west of Town U. Town W is to the south of Town V. Town X is to the west of Town W. What is the position of Town X with respect to Town S?
solution:
• Town T is to the west of Town S.
 
• Town U is to the south of Town T.
 
• Town V is to the west of Town U.
 
• Town W is to the south of Town V.
 
• Town X is to the west of Town W
